# Unit Tests of the Benchmarking Code {#sec-appendix-unit-tests}

| Test ID | Part Tested | Input | Expected Result | Actual Result | Status |
|:------|:--------------|:----------------------|:----------------------|:--------------|:-------|
| UT-01 | Share of each day in proportion to its matching posts | Sample size = 50. Matching posts on Days 1, 2, and 3 = 600, 300, and 100 | Shares on Days 1, 2, and 3 = 30, 15, and 5 |  |  |
| UT-02 | Share of each day when one day has too few eligible posts | Sample size = 50. Matching posts on Days 1, 2, and 3 = 600, 300, and 100. Eligible posts on Day 3 = 2 | Share on Day 3 = 2. Shares on all three days = 50 in total. Day 1 given more of the 3 remaining posts than Day 2 **[To be checked against the code. Section 3.5 states only that a day with more matching posts receives more of the remaining posts]** |  |  |
| UT-03 | Inclusion of a post with both Tagalog and English words | Post = "Baha na sa amin, please send help" | Included |  |  |
| UT-04 | Exclusion of posts that lack either Tagalog or English words | Post 1 = "Baha na naman sa amin". Post 2 = "Stay safe everyone" | Both excluded |  |  |
| UT-05 | Exclusion of reposts and quotes | Post 1 = a repost of an included post. Post 2 = a quote of an included post | Both excluded |  |  |
| UT-06 | Removal of exact duplicates that differ only in a link | Post 1 = "Baha na sa Marikina, ingat everyone https://t.co/abc". Post 2 = "Baha na sa Marikina, ingat everyone https://t.co/xyz" | One of the two posts kept |  |  |
| UT-07 | Removal of near duplicates above the similarity threshold of 0.75 | Post 1 = "baha sa marikina". Post 2 = "baha sa marikina ngayon" | Cosine similarity = 0.85. One of the two posts kept |  |  |
| UT-08 | Keeping of similar posts below the similarity threshold of 0.75 | Post 1 = "baha sa marikina". Post 2 = "baha sa cainta kahapon" | Cosine similarity = 0.51. Both posts kept |  |  |
| UT-09 | Replacement of personal details with placeholders | A post that contains a username, a phone number, an email address, a link, and a person's name | Username, phone number, email address, and link each replaced with a placeholder. Person's name unchanged |  |  |
| UT-10 | Split into training, validation, and test sets, stratified by category | 100 posts, 50 in category A and 50 in category B | Training set = 36 A and 36 B. Validation set = 7 A and 7 B. Test set = 7 A and 7 B. No post in more than one set. The same split on every run |  |  |
| UT-11 | Subsets of the training set for the learning curve | 200 training posts, 100 in category A and 100 in category B | 25% = 25 A and 25 B. 50% = 50 A and 50 B. 75% = 75 A and 75 B. Every post of each subset also in the next larger subset |  |  |
